name: Torrents is a Leisure tab only, and it highlights when open

actions.comment: Social must no longer carry a Torrents tab.
Opening /torrents must land in Leisure with the Torrents tab actually lit — the half that used to break, because viewToGroup could only map the view to one of the two groups.
actions.value: JSON.stringify({ url: location.pathname, group: document.querySelector('.header-nav-group')?.textContent?.trim(), tabs: [...document.querySelectorAll('.tabrail-tab')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()), current: document.querySelector('.tabrail-tab[aria-current="page"]')?.textContent?.trim(), activePill: document.querySelector('.tabrail-tab.active')?.textContent?.trim(), litRailGroup: document.querySelector('.sidebar .nav-item.active .nav-label')?.textContent?.trim() })
